name: qa-contract-testing
description: Contract testing for microservices: Pact consumer and provider tests, OpenAPI, GraphQL and Protobuf breaking-change checks, and a combined deploy gate. The gate aggregates Pact can-i-deploy, oasdiff, graphql-inspector and buf breaking into one go / no-go verdict. Agents (contract-drift-investigator, contract-test-scaffolder) trace contract drift to its source and scaffold contract tests from a spec.
